findings.suggested_fix: Given the S-1 appointments (4/25/3/2) plus one outside the date range, with Any status, then the total reads "34 appointment(s)" and the four displayed counts sum to that displayed total.
findings.text: S-2 AC4 asserts fixed arithmetic (4+25+3+2=34) instead of checking the displayed counts against the displayed total; it cannot fail if counts are computed differently from the list query, the risk req.md names.

cites.quote: Given a doctor who has a Completed appointment one day after the end of the selected date range
The counts cover every appointment that matches the current doctor, patient and date range filters, not only the current page.

findings.suggested_fix: Add an AC: a Completed appointment on the last day of the range is included in the Completed count, alongside the one-day-after exclusion.
findings.text: REQ-4 date-range boundary only tests an appointment one day after the range; an implementation treating the end date as exclusive passes. No AC checks an appointment on the last day of the range is counted.

cites.quote: then the Scheduled count includes only the first doctor's appointments
The counts cover every appointment that matches the current doctor, patient and date range filters, not only the current page.

findings.suggested_fix: Add an AC: given another patient has appointments in the same range, the first patient's list counts only that patient's appointments.
findings.text: REQ-4 names doctor and patient filters, but the exclusion case covers only another doctor's appointments; no AC shows a patient list's counts exclude other patients' appointments.

cites.quote: then the table rows and the total change to the new range as before the change

findings.suggested_fix: State the observable result, e.g. rows only within the new range, ordered by start time ascending, and the total equal to that row count.
findings.text: S-4 AC1 and AC3 state the expected result as 'exactly as before the change' / 'as before the change' rather than an observable outcome, which makes them harder to check.

rubric_items.reason: All eleven known REQs (REQ-1..REQ-11) are traced by at least one story; no assumed REQs exist.
Stories are small and mostly single-outcome; S-1 bundles display, order, Status-filter independence and zero counts, which is acceptable but broad.
ACs are Given/When/Then, but S-2 AC4 is a tautology, the date-range AC does not catch an exclusive-end bug, and REQ-4's patient-filter exclusion has no case.
Counts 4/25/3/2 and total 34 come from the ticket example; 20 and 21 derive from the 20-per-page rule in REQ-10.
Clear, consistent status terms; a few regression ACs rely on 'as before the change' rather than an observable expectation.
